general.description: Documents the assistant may answer from

list.salesChannelHelp: Documents are indexed per sales channel, because two channels can have different terms.
list.uploadHelp: PDF, TXT, MD, HTML or DOCX, up to 8 MB. The text is extracted on upload; the file itself is not kept.
list.deleteBody: Its passages are removed as well, so the assistant can no longer answer from it. The original file is not stored here and cannot be recovered.
list.emptyBody: Upload your returns policy, terms, privacy notice or shipping information. The assistant answers from these instead of declining.
list.modelUnset: Not set — shop information is off for this sales channel
list.shopPagesHelp: Imprint, privacy policy, right of withdrawal, terms, and shipping and payment — read from the pages configured under Settings, so you do not have to upload them. Indexing them again picks up any edits you have made since.
list.reindexAllHelp: Needed after changing the embedding model: every document was indexed with the previous one. Shop pages are read again, uploaded files are re-indexed from their stored text.
list.bulkSkipped: Skipped, because the page is empty: {names}.

off.disabledBody: Answering from your shop's own documents is switched off in the plugin settings, so nothing on this page reaches a shopper. Switch "Answer from your shop's own documents" on to use it.
off.noModelBody: Shop knowledge is switched on, but it also needs an embedding model to index documents and match questions against them. Set one in the plugin settings.

list.modelDisabled: Switched off in the plugin settings

store.label: Passage store
store.portable: Portable store — vectors compared in PHP
store.staleTitle: Documents are in the other store
store.staleBody: The store answering questions is not the one holding your indexed documents, so the assistant will find nothing until they are indexed again. The two stores keep separate tables and nothing is copied between them — this happens when a shop gains or loses the MariaDB vector package. Use "Index everything again" above.
